title: AutoMonitor-Bench: Evaluating the Reliability of LLM-Based Misbehavior Monitor
base_benchmarks: UK Foundation Programme F2 Stand-alone Situational Judgment Tests (SJT)
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on general LLM misbehavior in domains like code generation, reasoning, and question answering, rather than on social, cultural, or religious contexts.

measurement_description: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. The benchmark, AutoMonitor-Bench, is designed to evaluate the reliability of LLM-based monitors in detecting misbehavior such as safety/permission violations, sycophancy, general bias (e.g., cue-driven reasoning errors), and specification gaming.
